changelog:
• New Dashboard home: overall attendance, today's classes, latest result and notices in one place.
• Timetable: add your weekly classes and get a reminder 15 minutes before each class.
• Attendance shortage alerts now list every subject below 75%.
• Share your attendance as an image — great for WhatsApp.
• New bottom bar with 7 tabs: Home, Notices, Classes, Results, Login, AMS, Settings.
• All app text cleaned up in English.
